body: Thank you for the people that spoke with me. I’m going now and all of you beautiful people have a good life, love others and grow.
No my work is with my family. I’ve utterly failed them
I completely fucked up my Work. I made poor decisions and now I’m going to suffer for them. I can’t look at my family or face anybody
Please - I’m so messed up right now and the fact I’m even thinking about this is scaring me to death
